35.04748,-78.86115: Campbelton. Colonial river port, incorporated in 1762. Later merged with Cross Creek to form the town of Fayetteville.
35.05167,-78.87861: Lafayette. On American tour, 1825, he visited Fayetteville (named for him, 1783) and stayed at home of Duncan McRae, on site of present courthouse.
35.05592,-78.89211: U.S. Arsenal. Authorized by Congress, 1836. Taken over by Confederacy, 1861. Destroyed March 1865, by Sherman. Ruins stand 2 blocks S.W.
35.05609,-78.87375: Warren Winslow 1810 1862. Acting Governor, 1854; Congressman, 1855-1861. Negotiated surrender of local U.S. arsenal in 1861. Grave 40 yds. SE.
